supervised_loss: Cross entropy on reviewed training targets only
regularizer: Forward KL( frozen base distribution || adapted model distribution ) on nonpadding teacher-forced training tokens only
kl_reduction: Sum over vocabulary, mean over nonpadding target tokens; do not divide by vocabulary size
optimization_mode: Teacher and student both use eval mode to disable base and adapter dropout; adapter gradients remain enabled. This is not a causal ablation of KL alone versus8032.
purpose: Single expanded-data actual adapter training; no hyperparameter sweep
optimizer_steps_rule: Round up to a multiple of8:160 * new_training_examples /216; preserve approximately the previous example exposure
packing: Same exact two/three independent complete-utterance concatenation as prior trial, only within each training-assigned chapter; no shared speaker assumed
old_corpus_role: Evaluation only, including sources; never regularization or rehearsal
new_validation_chapter_role: Evaluation only; freeze references before generation
gate_success_only_permits: Native export/parity and production OCR/overlay/end-to-end validation; not installation or an app failure-rate claim
